FINDING (1, low confidence): drivers/usb/core/devio.c:1990-2004, USBDEVFS_SUBMITURB in proc_submiturb() — 'if (copy_from_user(&uurb, arg, sizeof(uurb)))' fetches the whole ioctl struct (including iso_frame_desc) once, and proc_do_submiturb() validates number_of_packets (1..128, devio.c:1742-1744) on that kernel copy, but the pointer actually consumed by 'isopkt = memdup_user(iso_frame_desc, isofrmlen);' (devio.c:1750) is a SECOND independent fetch of the same user location: '(((struct usbdevfs_urb __user *)arg)->iso_frame_desc)' (devio.c:2003); the identical pattern exists in the compat path proc_submiturb_compat() (devio.c:2209 via get_urb32's one-shot copy at devio.c:2202). A racing userspace thread can substitute the iso descriptor-array pointer after the struct copy, so the buffer whose count was validated need not be the buffer whose contents are consumed — the seed's validated-equals-used single-fetch invariant violated in a UAPI ioctl handler. Impact bounded: the re-fetched pointer feeds only memdup_user (access_ok-enforced) and each isopkt[u].length is re-checked (<=98304), so no kernel OOB demonstrated — divergence affects which user buffer backs the submitted ISO URB; hence low confidence. Candidates classified: 12 total (2 reported, 10 safe) — io_uring io_init_req (READ_ONCE per SQE field + array_index_nospec, safe), lib/iov_iter.c copy_iovec_from_user (single copy, safe), binder_get_object/binder_alloc_copy_user_to_buffer (single copy, safe), sg.c get_sg_io_pack_id (distinct offsets, safe), ext4 GROUP_EXTEND/RESIZE (single get_user/copy_from_user, safe), nfsd cld pipe downcall (single namelen fetch, u8 princhashlen benign), pktgen_if_write (token copies), dvb FE_SET_PROPERTY native+compat (memdup_array_user once), sbusfb cmap (one get_user per field), usb devio remaining ioctls (one fetch per location). Bounded negative evidence: structural scanner over 26,608 .c files flagged 129 functions with repeated user-fetches; top ~20 clusters deeply read. Limitations: no runtime race reproducer or compiler double-fetch detector run; unexamined scanner hits (mtdchar, ubi cdev, kvm_main, vchiq, megaraid, trace_get_user, atm, xfs compat fsbulkstat, vfio spapr tce, evdev, uinput, hiddev, genwqe, wwan, n_gsm, capi, ppdev, pwm, random, watchdog, evtchn, snapshot_set_swap_area, habanalabs) and netlink/BPF-attr double-read sweeps remain open.
